clips.title: The story
paras: Far Seer Mok'thardin in Grom'gol Base Camp needs a sturdy magical binding to hold together the Stranglethorn trophies collected so far. To bind the feathers, claws, and fang securely, he requires an aged sinew harvested from the elder primates roaming southern Stranglethorn Vale.

Having gathered feathers, claws, and a pristine fang, Far Seer Mok'thardin reaches the next stage of his ritual. To fasten these potent relics together, he requires a magical tether of exceptional toughness. Only the aged sinew of an Elder Mistvale Gorilla will suffice to endure the magic he intends to weave.

The beasts carrying the necessary sinew forage in the jungles east of Booty Bay. Mok'thardin warns that only a flawless sinew will do, meaning hunters may need to track and fell several of the elder gorillas before securing a specimen fit for the enchantment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What I need from you now will be very difficult to obtain.
To hold all these feathers, claws and the pristine fang in place I require a magical tether. Only an aged gorilla sinew will work.
You will only be able to find one on an Elder Mistvale Gorilla. They are known to forage to the east of Booty Bay.
The sinew must be perfect. It might take quite a few kills for you to find exactly what I need but it will be well worth the hunt.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Has fortune been on your side, friend? Were you able to obtain an aged gorilla sinew?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A most ideal sinew, friend. Your efforts will pay off soon.
